items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: Joey’s wife Linda participated briefly in the interview.

ctx.x: Trumpeter and vocalist Joey Morant is a dynamic performer who evokes the spirit of Louis Armstrong and Red Allen. He has shared the stage with Ray Charles, Lionel Hampton and Count Basie, and his consummate skills as an entertainer have found a welcome home with the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band.
Joey was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 2, 2013 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Joey’s wife Linda participated briefly in the interview.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. And I’m happy to have Joey Morant with me today. And I’m not sure how to describe you. Because musician doesn’t do all of it. But you are an entertainer.
